samples.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend B and suggest similar ways to keep some scale: peer practice, a scorecard, and a short auto-scored knowledge check. B has a smaller problem of its own: it describes three role-plays but has each rep play the customer once and the rep once, and with the demo it may not fit in 2 hours.

pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers recommend B with peer role-plays and one lead-observed round per rep, and both explain the difference between recognizing an answer and giving one. B also gives the VP a better scalable piece: a small scenario-based check used as a gate before the live round. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers recommend B with peer role-plays and the lead observing one round per rep, and both say clearly that a multiple-choice test shows recognition, not live performance.
